# Make NPCs Talk

Make NPCs in a game talk back: the player speaks or types, the NPC answers in character, in a cloned Fish Audio voice, about 1-2 seconds later, and can act on what was said — the whole loop, the four hooks a game must provide, engine choices (fal speech-to-text, a Cerebras LLM, Fish Audio Drama 3 or S2 Pro on a Modal GPU, TypeSafe Jev actions), latency budgets, costs and rules.
